verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion control is a fair axis for an observability SaaS that stores customer telemetry, so it applies. However, the pack documents no user-configurable retention period and no way to delete telemetry data. The only retention mention notes that SLO values are tracked past 'your retention period' without saying the user can set it. Generic API management of 'datasets' and deleting markers are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, and EU/NA region selection is data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
